Hey everyone — this is a little tool I've made for creating AI images in a really easy way. You describe the photo you want in plain English, and it makes it from a few reference pictures of you.

The useful bit: it runs the same idea through several AI models at once and puts the results side by side, so you just pick the one that got it right.

It's what I'm working on right now on the live show. If you'd like to try it out, come by and I'll show you how to get it installed — it could be useful for you too.

Link to the show and the code in the comments.
